subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI support guarded positional/cyclic session or agent switching shortcuts, and if so which bindings and ordering should be the supported contract?
rationale: This is new keyboard behavior, not a broken existing contract, and the requested chords can conflict with browser/OS shortcuts while changing active session state.

options.title: Add Coordinated Guarded Shortcuts
options.body: Adopt non-conflicting bindings and implement them through the same guarded dashboard dispatcher used for adjacent Control UI shortcuts, with active-agent ordering tests.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions View
options.body: Keep this issue open as part of the broader sessions-view product work and avoid adding standalone positional shortcuts now.

options.title: Decline Browser-Level Chords
options.body: Close the shortcut direction after documenting that session switching should stay picker/sidebar or command-palette driven to avoid browser shortcut conflicts.

recommendation.title: Add Coordinated Guarded Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Adopt non-conflicting bindings and implement them through the same guarded dashboard dispatcher used for adjacent Control UI shortcuts, with active-agent ordering tests.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the adjacent guarded dashboard shortcut issue/PR and has the closest current product context for shortcut contract choices.
